name: Jen
source:
A college student who, after going along with a summoning ritual one Halloween night, finds herself hosting Girl Dracula in her apartment. Though she's kind at heart, her patience with the little vampire has started to wear thin...

[From [url=https://air-gong.itch.io/the-intern-of-christmas-present]Itch.io[/url]]
